  Readable gloss: "Sphragis denotes both the physical seal-device (a signet ring or stamp) and the mark it leaves. In the ancient world, seals authenticated documents, secured tombs, and indicated ownership. Paul calls Abraham’s circumcision a seal of the righteousness he had by faith (Rom 4:11) and the Corinthian believers the seal of his apostleship (1 Cor 9:2). The Apocalypse gives the word dramatic prominence: the scroll sealed with seven seals can be opened only by the Lamb (Rev 5:1-9; 6:1-12). God’s firm foundation bears a seal of divine ownership (2 Tim 2:19). Spanish sello, French sceau, and German Siegel consistently render the same concept."
